5.name: Hostile Takeover
5.desc: Super-Skrull: Each time you activate a Fury Buff there is a 100% Chance to place an Armor Break on the Opponent lasting 4 seconds, reducing Armor by [150]. Max Stacks: 5.Iron Fist: The first 4 of Iron Fist's personal Armor Break Debuffs start paused. While the opponent is suffering any Armor Break Debuffs the next Buff triggered on them will be immediately Nullified and an Armor Break Debuff is consumed.

7.name: H.E.R.B.I.E.
7.desc: Other Synergy Champions: If at or below 20% health at the start of the fight, heal 10% of Max Health over 6 second(s). Otherwise gain 60% of a Bar of Power over 6 seconds(s) instead.

8.name: Force Block
8.desc: Other Synergy Champions: Block Proficiency increased by 5%. Perfect Block chance increased by 10%. If all other Champions in this Synergy are present, Well-Timed Blocks inflict up to one 10% Weakness Debuff on the Opponent for 6 second(s).

9.name: Rain of Fire
9.desc: Other Synergy Champions: The last hit of Special Attack 1 Incinerates the Opponent for 6 second(s). This also inflicts Heal Block if all other Champions in this Synergy are present.

10.name: The Brave and the Boulder
10.desc: Other Synergy Champions: The last hit of Special Attack 2 grants a Fury Buff for 6 seconds, increasing Attack by 15% of Base Attack. This effect is doubled if all other Champions in this Synergy are present.

17.name: Sibling Rivalry
17.desc: Gamora: Robot opponents suffer -10% Ability Accuracy and -2% Attack Rating for each personal Buff on Gamora.Nebula: The first Special 1 each fight is a guaranteed Critical Hit. The same is true for the first Special 2.All Synergy Champions: +5% Attack Rating.

25.name: How much for the arms?
25.desc: Rocket Raccoon: When Rocket inflicts Armor Break using his Heavy Attack, he gains an Armor Up Buff increasing Armor Rating by [400] for 10 seconds. Max: 5.Winter Soldier: Activating a Special grants a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by [400] for 5 seconds. While it is active, Bucky's Personal Abilities gain a flat +10% chance to trigger.Misty Knight: Whenever Misty would gain 2 Anti-Metal or Cryogenic Charges, she gains 3 instead.

27.name: Fairest of them All

28.name: Abominable Comrade
28.desc: Abomination (Immortal), Abomination: Each time a Poison Debuff expires or is removed from the Opponent there is a 5% chance to inflict an Enervate Debuff for 3 seconds, preventing Power gained when struck.

31.name: The Worthy
31.desc: Absorbing Man: The second Medium Attack inflicts an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor by [500] for 9 seconds. Max Stacks: 5.Thor: Thor's Heavy Attack inflicts an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor by [1,800] for 4.5 seconds. Max Stacks: 2.Thor (Jane Foster): When facing Cosmic Champions, The Mighty Thor inflicts Degeneration effects instead of personal Shocks, which count as Shocks for her abilities.

33.name: Hands-On Approach
33.desc: Absorbing Man: Reduce the duration of non-damaging Debuffs other than Stuns by 50%.Rogue: The timer for Rogue's Replicated Buffs is paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

34.name: The Green Door
34.desc: Absorbing Man: Gain Immunity to Poison effects, and Omni-Morph Forms last 3 seconds longer.Abomination (Immortal): Gain [250] Energy Resistance for each Poison effect on himself.Hulk (Immortal): Immortality gains +20% Ability Accuracy.

36.name: Massive Gains

While this Charge is active, starting a Heavy Charge while the Opponent is within striking Distance inflicts a Stun Passive for 0.6 seconds and consumes the Charge.

52.name: Vampyrsk, the Vampire Kingdom
52.desc: Dracula: At the start of each fight, rapidly gain 25% of a Bar of Power for each other unique Synergy Champion present.Synergy Champions: Interrupting any attack inflicts a Bleed Debuff dealing 20% of Attack as Direct Damage over 8 seconds.Storm, Jubilee, Black Panther: While fighting a #Silver Champion, these Synergy Champions suffer -25% Regeneration Rate.

57.name: Everyone Must Be Lizards!
57.desc: All Champions gain a Lizard Regeneration Passive at the start of each fight, granting +[600] Attack Rating and recovering 2% of Base Health over 20 seconds.Synergy Champions: Increase the amount healed by Lizard Regeneration by +3% flat.

58.name: Just Another Sinister Six
58.desc: Synergy Champions: When fighting against #Spider-Verse Heroes, on Special Attack activation, gain a Pursuit Passive for 13 seconds.

59.name: Crazy Scientists
59.desc: Lizard: Personal Unstoppable lasts +2 seconds.M.O.D.O.K.: At the end of Special 1, inflict a non-stacking 100% Petrify Debuff for 4 seconds.Mister Sinister: When the Opponent fails to Purify one or more Debuffs due to reduced Ability Accuracy, self-inflict a personal Bleed Debuff.The Overseer: Against Mystic Champions, gain a Steadfast Passive while at or above 3 Gamma Power.

60.name: Mean Greens
60.desc: Lizard: When the Opponent is inflicted with a non-Damaging Debuff other than the Parry Mastery Stun, inflict a personal Rupture.Sauron: If the Opponent Purifies or Cleanses the Parry Mastery Stun, gain an Unstoppable Passive for 1 second.Man-Thing: Each hit of Special 2 Nullifies 1 extra Buff.

64.name: Which Universe Are You Again?
64.desc: The Overseer, Pavitr: While the Opponent has more than 2 Bars of Power, inflict a 65% Wither Debuff (Overseer) or Passive (Pavitr).The Maker, Shathra: While charging or releasing a Heavy Attack, Evade the first incoming Basic Attack. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
